# APK Security Hardening Report — OWASP MASVS Audit

**Target:** `com.luminia.auth` v1.0.0-PROD-AIRGAP
**Scope:** `AndroidManifest.xml`, `DuressAuthManager.kt`, `PasscodeManager.kt`
**Framework:** OWASP MASVS v2 (STORAGE / CRYPTO / AUTH / PLATFORM)

---

## 1. Manifest — Component Exposure & Backup (MASVS-PLATFORM-1, MASVS-STORAGE-2)

| Control | Status | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| `allowBackup` | ✅ PASS | `false`, `fullBackupContent=false`, `dataExtractionRules=@null` — no ADB/cloud exfil of vault state. |
| `usesCleartextTraffic` | ✅ PASS | `false` + `networkSecurityConfig`; no `INTERNET` permission (air-gap enforced). |
| `DirectBootSanitizerReceiver` | ✅ PASS | `exported=false`, `directBootAware=true` — correct. |
| `MainActivity` / `LuminiaComposeActivity` | ⚠️ REVIEW | `exported=true` is required for LAUNCHER, but `MainActivity` has **no intent-filter** yet is exported — unnecessary attack surface. |
| `RECEIVE_DURESS` permission | ✅ PASS | `protectionLevel=signature` — only same-signer AOSP services can trigger duress. |
| `excludeFromRecents` / `autoRemoveFromRecents` | ✅ PASS | Prevents thumbnail leakage of vault UI. |

**Remediation:** Set `MainActivity` `android:exported="false"` (it is not a launcher entry point).

---

## 2. StrongBox / Hardware-Backed Key Storage (MASVS-CRYPTO-1)

`PasscodeManager.initSecurePreferences()` correctly requests `setRequestStrongBoxBacked(true)` with a **graceful fallback** to TEE-backed AES256_GCM, then to plain `MODE_PRIVATE`.
